title: GTA 6 Ultimate Edition unlocks: up to 60 hours away
description: GTA 6 Ultimate Edition unlocks are tied to the story, some are temporary, and late-game items can take nearly 60 hours to reach, says Eurogamer.

body.text: GTA 6 Ultimate Edition unlocks work differently from what many buyers expected. According to Eurogamer, which cites IGN's full breakdown, almost none of the bonus content is available from the start. You have to earn it by playing through the main story, and some of it only lasts for a single chapter. That matters because Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick has said the Ultimate Edition is the version most people are buying.
What the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition includes

The Ultimate Edition costs $100 (£90) and adds exclusive vehicles, weapons, shops and more. Rockstar had said the bonuses become available to Jason and Lucia across their story, with new items uncovered behind each chapter. What it hadn't made clear was how long that would take. Eurogamer says details started to emerge as the game launched in some parts of the world.
GTA 6 Ultimate Edition unlocks by chapter

The Ultimate Edition-exclusive shops open during Chapter 1. Many of the other additions arrive by the end of Chapter 2, which sounds quick but isn't. Eurogamer's Chris Tapsell says getting there could take upward of 25 hours.
The later rewards take far longer. Eurogamer lists these examples:

items: Chapter 4: the Shitzu Squalo, plus the Vice City Style outfits and tattoos
Estimated playtime for these late unlocks: close to 60 hours

body.text: Tapsell adds that the timing depends on how tightly you focus on the story. His estimate assumes a player doing the main story and the optional character-based missions in roughly chronological order.
Some Ultimate Edition content is temporary

The more surprising detail is that some items aren't permanent. Jason's Dinka Enduro motorcycle and the Crest Kayak can only be used during Chapter 1. The same goes for his retro Vapid Ganado, which comes from the Coastal Auto Care mod shop in Key Lento. If you want to try them, do it before you move on.

Players who expected everything immediately, and permanently, may be disappointed. Eurogamer's counterpoint is that 60 hours of GTA 6 is hardly a chore. Its five-star review calls the game an "irreducible mix of silliness, intimacy, grand ideas and rock 'n' roll action".

Watch how players react once the game is widely available. The main questions are whether Rockstar clarifies which items are temporary and whether the unlock pacing draws more complaints. Check the in-game shop details before you plan your first playthrough around specific Ultimate Edition items.

faqs.q: When do GTA 6 Ultimate Edition unlocks become available?
faqs.a: According to Eurogamer, citing IGN's full unlock details, almost all Ultimate Edition content requires story progress. The exclusive shops unlock in Chapter 1, and many other additions arrive by the end of Chapter 2.

faqs.q: How long does it take to unlock everything in the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition?
faqs.a: Eurogamer's Chris Tapsell says reaching the end of Chapter 2 could take upward of 25 hours. Late-game items like the 95 Grotti Cheetah in Chapter 5 could be close to 60 hours away.

faqs.q: Are all GTA 6 Ultimate Edition items permanent?
faqs.a: No. Eurogamer reports that some items are temporary and usable only in certain chapters. Jason's Dinka Enduro motorcycle, the Crest Kayak and a retro Vapid Ganado are only available in Chapter 1.

sources.title: PSA: Some GTA 6 Ultimate Edition content is only available for the first chapter, and you'll have to put in hard graft to unlock more
